You may edit ONLY these files: tests/test_richer_1c.py, tests/test_richer_2a.py, tests/test_richer_2b.py, tests/test_richer_2c.py, tests/test_richer_3a.py, tests/scene_harness.py (new), tests/fixtures/scene_commands.json (new), tests/test_scene_commands_reach_reveals.py (new) and tests/shard_durations.json (one entry for the new test file, same format as its neighbours, value 3.0). No production code. Nothing else.

PROBLEM. The owner finds that editing near-identical test functions takes too long. Each of the five files tests/test_richer_{1c,2a,2b,2c,3a}.py has a function named `test_existing_<scene>_commands_still_reach_their_reveals` that loops over `(true_facts, command, expected_reveal_id[, turn_index])` tuples, builds an engine with a file-local `_engine(...)` helper and asserts `_handoff(...)` finds the expected candidate. The `_engine` and `_handoff` helpers are copied in each file (1c and 2a are identical to each other; 2b, 2c and 3a are identical to each other and add `turn_index`).

CHANGE, TEST FIRST.
1. tests/scene_harness.py: `scene_engine(package, scene_id, *, true_facts=(), turn_index=0) -> tuple[RuntimeState, RuntimeEngine]` and `authored_handoff(engine, state, command)`, exactly the behaviour of the file-local helpers (copy their bodies; read all five files and confirm they match; if a file differs in a way that matters, keep that difference as a parameter and say so in NOTES.txt). Make the five files use it: replace each file's local `_engine` and `_handoff` bodies by thin wrappers (for example `def _engine(**kwargs): return scene_engine(PACKAGE, "2B", **kwargs)`) so no other test in those files has to change. Keep each file's other tests byte for byte.
2. tests/fixtures/scene_commands.json: a JSON list of cases `{"scene": "1C", "true_facts": [...], "command": "...", "expected": "k_...", "turn_index": 0}` holding EXACTLY the tuples of the five old functions (1C 4, 2A 4, 2B 4, 2C 3, 3A 3 = 18 cases; for 2A and 3A build the fact lists the way the old functions did, e.g. expand `new_reveals` and `ARRIVED` into the literal fact ids; keep the case order of each old function).
3. tests/test_scene_commands_reach_reveals.py: ONE parametrized test over that table (`pytest.param(..., id="<scene>-<expected>-<n>")`), loading the real package once (module scope, `load_story_package(Path('data/stories/continuity-initiative'))` like the old files) and asserting what the old functions asserted, with the command in the failure message.
4. Delete the five old `test_existing_*_commands_still_reach_their_reveals` functions and any import that becomes unused. Do not delete or change any other test.
Run the five files and the new test. The five files must collect exactly 47 tests together (52 before minus the five removed) and the new file at least 18.

set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-30
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git reset -q
git add -A -- tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep -vE '^(tests/test_richer_1c\.py|tests/test_richer_2a\.py|tests/test_richer_2b\.py|tests/test_richer_2c\.py|tests/test_richer_3a\.py|tests/scene_harness\.py|tests/fixtures/scene_commands\.json|tests/test_scene_commands_reach_reveals\.py|tests/shard_durations\.json)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
start=$(date +%s)
before=$(.venv/bin/python -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_richer_1c.py tests/test_richer_2a.py tests/test_richer_2b.py tests/test_richer_2c.py tests/test_richer_3a.py 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')
echo "collected in the five richer files: $before"
[ "$before" -eq 47 ] || { echo "expected exactly 47 tests in the five files (52 minus the five old functions), got $before"; exit 1; }
new=$(.venv/bin/python -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_scene_commands_reach_reveals.py 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::')
[ "$new" -ge 18 ] || { echo "new test collects $new cases, need >= 18"; exit 1; }
if grep -n "def test_existing_.*still_reach" tests/test_richer_1c.py tests/test_richer_2a.py tests/test_richer_2b.py tests/test_richer_2c.py tests/test_richer_3a.py; then echo "an old test_existing_* function is still present"; exit 1; fi
out=$(.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -rs -n 4 tests/test_scene_commands_reach_reveals.py tests/test_richer_1c.py tests/test_richer_2a.py tests/test_richer_2b.py tests/test_richer_2c.py tests/test_richer_3a.py 2>&1) || { echo "$out"; exit 1; }
echo "$out" | tail -4
case "$out" in *skipped*) echo "tests were skipped"; exit 1;; esac
.venv/bin/python - <<'PYV'
import json
cases = json.load(open("tests/fixtures/scene_commands.json"))
from collections import Counter
c = Counter(x["scene"] for x in cases)
assert c == {"1C": 4, "2A": 4, "2B": 4, "2C": 3, "3A": 3}, c
assert all(set(x) >= {"scene", "true_facts", "command", "expected"} for x in cases)
PYV
cp tests/fixtures/scene_commands.json "$WORK/out/scene_commands.backup"
.venv/bin/python - <<'PYM'
import json
p = "tests/fixtures/scene_commands.json"
cases = json.load(open(p))
cases[0]["expected"] = "k_deliberately_wrong"
json.dump(cases, open(p, "w"))
PYM
if .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_scene_commands_reach_reveals.py > "$WORK/out/mutation.txt" 2>&1; then echo "MUTATION SURVIVED: the table test passes with a wrong expected id"; cp "$WORK/out/scene_commands.backup" tests/fixtures/scene_commands.json; exit 1; fi
cp "$WORK/out/scene_commands.backup" tests/fixtures/scene_commands.json
echo "mutation check: the table test fails when an expected id is wrong"
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_scene_commands_reach_reveals.py 2>&1 | tail -2
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "took $took s (budget 360 s)"
[ "$took" -le 360 ] || { echo "over the 360 s budget"; exit 1; }
grep -q '"tests/test_scene_commands_reach_reveals.py"' tests/shard_durations.json || { echo "shard_durations lacks the new test"; exit 1; }
.venv/bin/python -m json.tool tests/shard_durations.json > /dev/null
git add -A -- tests
PYFILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=d | grep '\.py$' || true)
echo "ruff files: $PYFILES"
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff check $PYFILES
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $PYFILES
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/scene-commands.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/scene-commands.patch"
tasks.verified: One table-driven test (18 cases) replaces the five per-scene functions, a shared harness replaces the copied helpers, and a wrong expected id makes it fail.
